chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Sinan, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Words of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'Surely, the first House Appointed for the people is the one at Bekka, Blessed and a Guidance for the nations. In it are clear Signs.' What are these clear Signs? He (peace be upon him) said: 'The Standing Place of Ibrahim, where he stood upon the stone, so his feet made an impression in it, and the Black Stone, and the house of Ismail (peace be upon him).'
ai.seo_question: What are the 'clear signs' in the Kaaba according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the 'clear signs' (ayatun bayinat) of the Kaaba by identifying them as the Maqam Ibrahim, the Black Stone, and the dwelling of Ismail, thereby grounding abstract divine guidance in tangible sacred relics. This interpretation highlights the Shia emphasis on the physical sanctity of these objects as enduring witnesses to the monotheistic legacy of Abraham and his son, reinforcing the spiritual significance of the Hajj rituals.
